verdict.rationale: An online tax-filing and licensing portal could plausibly offer user-defined automation, such as rules that trigger payments or filings on events, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no user-defined event-triggered rules. The Small Business Credit auto-calculation is a fixed system behavior, not a user rule. ACH debit is a one-off payment, not an event-driven or recurring trigger.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
